cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / MUDUKULATTUR TALUK · MUDUKULATTUR TALUK. Tirumaḷugaṇḍakkōṭṭai † — Tamil Nadu

cells.place: RAMNAD DISTRICT-cont. MUDUKULATTUR TALUK-cont. Tirumālugaṇḍankōṭṭai-cont. On the east wall of the ardha-maṇḍapa in the shrine in the Sōmanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Seems to register the remission of taxes on lands at Śirīyānkulam purchased for the temple, sometime previously, by two private individuals. The transaction was to take effect from the 10th year, Āppaśi.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / MUDUKULATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-cont. / MUDUKULATTUR TALUK-cont. † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall at the right entrance into the shrine in the Sōmanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Do. Registers the assignment of taxes on certain lands to the temple for special offerings etc. in every month on the day of Mūla, the natal star of the king's father (ayya).

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / MUDUKULATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-cont. / MUDUKULATTUR TALUK-cont. † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall at the right and left of the entrance into the shrine in the Sōmanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Stones lost in the middle. Registers the agreement, given by the Śrī-Rudras of the temple to the (temple) dancing women (īruvarāṅga kuḍugai) regarding properties given and utilized for them and their descendants in grain or land.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / MUDUKULATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-cont. / MUDUKULATTUR TALUK-cont. † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Onstray stones built into the north wall of the shrine in the Sōmanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to register a grant of tax-free land to the temple. Mentions the villages Iānguḍi in Kiḍāram nāḍu and Kōnērikuḍi.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / MUDUKULATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-cont. / MUDUKULATTUR TALUK-cont. † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north and west walls of the shrine in the Sōmanāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Commences with the introduction Pūmalar tiruvarum etc. Stones lost in the middle. Mentions malai-maṇḍalam for offerings etc. to the god Irukaimaḍāvārup-piḷaiyar. Mentions Ayyar Malava-rāyan.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / MUDUKULATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-cont. / MUDUKULATTUR TALUK-cont. † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: Onstray stones built into the north, west and south walls of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Connects with the introduction Pūmaruviya tiru-, muḍandaiyum etc. of king Māravarman Sundara-Pāṇḍya I. Stones misplaced and some lost. Seems to register the royal order issued at the instance of a certain (named) officer, communicating the kaikkol-tūrkullam which were assigned to the lease Ottawa-muḷaiyār by Kaṇḍiyarūṉ. Gives full details regard-ing the grant of uḷavuru for the lands.

cells.location: RAMNAD DISTRICT / MUDUKULATTUR TALUK · RAMNAD DISTRICT-cont. / MUDUKULATTUR TALUK-cont. † — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the lease of certain dīradāna lands. Mentions Viśvappa-Nāyaka. Alāttūn-nadu and Tirumāvugandānkōṭtai.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / PALNI TALUK · MADURA DISTRICT. PALNI TALUK. Virupākshi — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: States that the steps of the Nīlāmaḷaiyāṅgar temple were the gift of Tiruvenkaṭaṅi-Śeṭṭi.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / PALNI TALUK · Devatūr — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Gives the introduction Pāmḍu puṇara etc. of king Vikrama-Chōḷa. Damaged and built in. Seems to register a sale of land to the temple by some private persons.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / PALNI TALUK · Tribhuvanam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the front gōpura of the Kampahārēśvara temple.
cells.remarks: Records the remission of the puravaru due to the temple of Tribhuvanēśvaramuḍaiyār from its maid-servants (dēva-dāsigaḷ) (padiyilar) of the temple.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / PALNI TALUK · Paruttikkudi — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register the gift of the village Paruttiyūr alias Dhīravīrapuram to the god Marudavappar (in the temple of) Madhyārjunēśvara by the village channel.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / PALNI TALUK · Paḍattalaivāṅkuḍi (hamlet of Paruttākkuḍi) — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: States that Padattalavankudi was the abhishēka-kaṭtalai village of the god Marudavāṇasvāmi. A similar inscription is engraved on a slab standing on the bank of the village channel.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / PALNI TALUK · Mahādēvapaṭṭiṉam — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a pillar in the maṇḍapa to the south of the Pushyamaṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Fragment. It details the lands with their prices purchased for the temple at different times from several individuals. In characters of about the 12th century.

cells.place: On a pillar in front of the central shrine of the Nāganāthasvāmin temple.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / PALNI TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the front gōpura of the Kampahārēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Registers the provision made for a perpetual lamp in the temple by the conversion of certain lands belonging to it into wet.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / PALNI TALUK · Tirungaśvaram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the front gōpura of the Kampahārēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to provide for a twilight lamp in the temple by Śuttamalliyār, the daughter of Ulaguḷanda-nāyaka, it into wet.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / PALNI TALUK · Tirungaśvaram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Gives the introduction Pugalmādu viḷaṅga, etc. Seems to record the assignment of some neglected pasture land to the temple for the provision of an oil-bath to the deity.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / PALNI TALUK · Tirunagēśvaram † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the front gōpura of the Kampahārēśvara temple †
cells.remarks: Built in the wall. Seems to register a sale of land to the temple by a private individual.

cells.location: MADURA DISTRICT / PALNI TALUK · Tirunagēśvaram † — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Records the royal order issued to the authorities of the temple at the instance of Yādavarāya, sanctioning the auction sale of lands which belonged to two individuals who had absconded and embezzled some money from the temple treasury and thus committed śivadrōha. Registers also the sale of the lands forming the ūrkanakkakāni of the same accountants.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Tiruppanandal † — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers sale of two villages to the temple.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Māmbāḍi † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west wall of the shrine in the Nāganāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Commences with the introduction Pugaļmādu vīlaņga etc. of Kulōttunga I. Records an agreement given by the Sivabrāhmaṇas and the sthārattūr of the temple to measure 111 kalam of paddy annually as interest on 44 kalam endowed by the merchant mentioned in No. 93 above in addition to the gift of the same land for the festival. Provision was also made for the enactment of akūttu and for feeding the devotees in the Baktagalbakta-matha.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · TANJORE DISTRICT—cont. / KUMBAKONAM TALUK—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: cont. On the west and south walls of the shrine in the Nāganāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Registers the order (sammāda-niyōga) issued by the Nagarattār of Viranārāyanapuram to the dēvakanmis and the Māhēśvaras of the temple of Śri-Kailāsa-muṣciyār, permitting the latter to supply daily during the seven days of the festival mentioned above, 2)000 lities from the tank called 'Nambinangai.' Mentions the Māhēśvara Mārambādi-Pichtcher,

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Manambadi † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the shrine in the Nāganāthasvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction Pū-mādu-puṇara. Ends of lines built in. Registers an agreement given by the Śivabrāhmaṇas of the temple of Kailāsa-muḍaiyā-Mahādēva to feed the Apūrv-Māhēśvaras (pilgrims) in the temple with the interest on the paddy money given them from a merchant of Gaṅgaikoṇḍa-śōḷapuram.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Manambadi † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the shrine in the Nāganāthasvāmin temple †
cells.remarks: Commences with the introduction Tirumanni valara etc. Damaged at the end. Records the agreement made by the Śivabrāhmaṇas of the temple of Maraikkāḍan muḍaiyār in Ilaiñchikkuḍi, a division of Rājēndra-śōḷa-vaḷanāḍu, situated in Milalai-nāḍu, a division of Vaḍagarai Rājēndra-śōḷa-vaḷanāḍu, to burn three peṭṭuḷ lamps for the money received by them from Nāgarattār of the temple, Bhāṭṭan, the headman of the village, and the Dēvarāḍiyār of Rājēndra-Chōḷadēva, i.e. the king.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · TANJORE DISTRICT—cont. / KUMBAKONAM TALUK—cont. — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the shrine in the Nāganāthasvāmin temple †
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land, free of taxes, by the Nāgarattār of I. Iachehikkudi alias Viranārāyanapuram for forming a flower-garden called after the king, for the temple,

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Sōlapuram — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west and south walls of the deserted temple to the north of the main road.
cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Ends of lines built in. Commences with the introduction Pugālśūlnda punari etc. Seems to record the remission, by the Nagatartat of Viranārāyanapuram, of taxes on certain lands purchased by some persons for the temple of Kulōttungacholīśvaram-Udaiyār.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Tiruvalliyaṅguḍi — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Kōḷavillirāman temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the eastern conquests of the king and the Śivabrāhmaṇas of the temple and the Chōḷa-maṇḍalam to which he made a gift of certain taxes (cf. A.R. for 1924-25, Part II, pa. a. 32.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Kurichehli — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east and west walls of the central shrine in the Kōḍaṇḍarāmasvāmin temple.
cells.remarks: Fragments. One of these seems to register a grant of land to Kōdaṇḍarāma, the son of Vayirna-Nayiṇār on the appointment of the first one as the accountant. In characters of the 15th cent. A.D.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Tirulōki — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in the Sundarēśvara temple.
cells.date: 19th year (in words) [see No. 104 below], Tuḷa, ba. 3, Thursday, Mṛigaśīrsha. [date-calculation appendix, No. 102: Nineteenth year, Tulā, ba. 3, Thursday, Mrigaśirsha. Probably A.D. 1236, October 18, Saturday (not Thursday as given in the inscription) ; ‘97; f.d.n. °67.]
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to register the agreement made by the Śivabrāhmaṇas to burn a twilight lamp in the temple of Tirulōki-uḍaiyār, etc. (Śiva) by Virudāra-bhayaṅkara-chaturvēdimangalam in Māmi-nāḍu, a subdivision of Virudāra-bhayaṅkara-vaḷanāḍu, for the gold received by them from a private individual.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Tirulōki † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in the Sundarēśvara temple. †
cells.date: 19th year (in words) [see No. 104 below], Tuḷa, ba. 3, Thursday, Mṛigaśīrsha.
cells.remarks: Commences with the introduction Pūmaruviya polililum Mutilated and portions lost, Seems to record the resettlement of the several kinds of lands under different categories, such as dēvadāna, brahmadēya, paḷḷichchandam rājakulavar-kāṇiyāṭchi, etc. The order is dated in the 4th year on the 358th day of the 3rd year Hasta, Tuesday, śu 6, of the Karkataka month in the fourth year.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Tirulōki † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in the Sundarēśvara temple †
cells.date: 19th year (in words) [see No. 104 below], Tuḷa, ba. 3, Thursday, Mṛigaśīrsha.
cells.remarks: Damaged at the end. Registers the royal order conferring on a certain Kōśali Tribhuvanachakravartin-kāḍavarāyar, the right of daily worship in the shrine of the goddess, in the Paraśurāmisvaram-Udaiyār Temple for all the thirty days (of the month) on the representation of Gaṇitachakravartin who founded the shrine. Mentions Svamidēvar.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Tirulōki † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in the Sundarēśvara temple. †
cells.date: 19th year (in words) [see No. 104 below], Tuḷa, ba. 3, Thursday, Mṛigaśīrsha.
cells.remarks: Stone-built. Contains lines built in. Contents similar to those of No. 92 above.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Tirulōki † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab built into the wall to the left of the entrance into the kitchen of the temple.
cells.date: 19th year (in words) [see No. 104 below], Tuḷa, ba. 3, Thursday, Mṛigaśīrsha.
cells.remarks: Refers to a building which was the gift of Tiruchchirrambalamuḍaiyār. Gives portion of the introduction Pūgalmādu viḷaṅga etc. Registers the grant of land, free of taxes, made to the temple of Mahādēva.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Tirulōki † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On another slab built into the wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the central shrine in the Sundarēśvara temple. †
cells.date: 19th year (in words) [see No. 104 below], Tuḷa, ba. 3, Thursday, Mṛigaśīrsha.
cells.remarks: (Fragment). Gives portion of the return for the money received previously from Varaguṇa-Perumāḷ for the expenses of the Margali festival. The grant was made for the prosperity of the king, the village and the country.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Tirulōki † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall (outside) of the same prākāra of the same temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged at the end. Registers the agreement made by four Śivabrāhmaṇas of the temple of Śrī-Kailāsamuḍaiyār to burn a twilight lamp for the money received by them from Dēvan Iḍaṅkondan alias Maṇḍayarayar of the village.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Tirulōki † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north and west walls of the central shrine in the Kailāsanātha temple.
cells.remarks: End portions damaged. Seems to register a similar agreement given by two Śivabrāhmaṇas.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Tirulōki † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the shrine in the Kailāsanātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Much damaged, contains portion of the introduction Tirumagaḷ Calara, etc. Seems to register the proceedings of the Mahāsabhā of the village for the sale of land-income of the temple. (Gonges water) refers to the event of Rājēndra-Chōḷadēva returning with the Gaṅgā another fragment and worshipping the deity.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Tirulōki † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the shrine in the Kailāsanātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Commences with the introduction. cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Tirulōki † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the shrine in the Kailāsanātha temple. †
cells.remarks: Unfinished. Mentions the (Śiva) temple at Śuṅganta-virttisāmi-janālu in Vīra-pāṇḍya-nāḍu, a subdivision of States that the ardha-maṇḍapa was the gift of the Bāla-sabhā, Modern.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Tirulōki † — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Unfinished. Mentions the (Śiva) temple at Śuṅganta-virttisāmi-janālu in Vīra-pāṇḍya-nāḍu, a subdivision of States that the ardha-maṇḍapa was the gift of the Bāla-sabhā, Modern.

cells.remarks: Unfinished. Mentions the (Śiva) temple at Śuṅganta-virttisāmi-janālu in Vīra-pāṇḍya-nāḍu, a subdivision of States that the ardha-maṇḍapa was the gift of the Bāla-sabhā, Modern.

cells.remarks: Commences with the introduction Pámaraṉiya poḻiḻum, etc. Registers the royal order assigning the proceeds of the sale of certain rights in the temple worship, and of sale of the tenancy rights, over the lands belonging to the temple, to one Sabhápatiyáma who had stolen gold from the temple treasure for the benefit of the temple. The order was signed by Sandhivigraham Vayirádaráyar.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · PANDANALLUR † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the inner gópura of the Pañpatiévara temple. †

cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to record the gift to the temple of a village in Vajudilampatṭtu-chavadi, situated between the Kolliḍam (Coleroon) and the Kāvēri in Virudarājabhayankara-valaṇādā.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · PANDANALLUR † — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Verses in praise of Kālingaṇ Ellaṇ. In characters of the 16th century.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · PANDANALLUR † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the outer gópura of the Pañpatiévara temple †
cells.remarks: Registers the order of the chief Kónéridáva-Maháráje, lord of Kánchi, assigning certain lands to the temple of the Paṇḍipéśvara-Mahádéva and Adikéśava- Perumáḷ.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Mentions Kúḷuttungachóḷa-Piḷḷaivaḷamudaiyáṉ.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Darauḷ — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: States that this shrine [?] was the gift of Káñjai Védártha-Paṇḍita Agnichit Sarvakratuyáji of [Kaḷḷu]ttiḍai.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Soḷḷivagan (hamlet of 'Vaṇṇikuḍi) — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Kaḍichohambaḍi — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Kaḍichohambaḍi † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east base of the mahámaṇḍapa in the Múśilámaṇivara temple.
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Registers a gift of land to Ártt-amudu Tákar by Mahámaṇḍalésvara Kempayyadéva as the gift for providing flower-garlands to the god Śárigapáṇi. Probably connected with the above inscription.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Tiruvalaiyur — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Incomplete. Registers the gift of a twilight lamp by native of Tirumaṇiyúr alias Pañcha[va]ṭimádévichaturvvédimangalam.

cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Majavarāya-Nādālyān of Pāṇdikulā-śaṇi-valanādu.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Nachchiyarkovil — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine of the Śrīnivāsa-Perumāḷ temple.
cells.remarks: Stones misplaced and some lost. Registers a sale of land by a native of Manalpākkam in Mēlīr-nādu, a subdivision of Jayaī[gonda] śola-maṇdalam, to the temple of Ulagtyyanīṇraruliṇa-Emberum[āṇ] at Tirunaraiyūr in Tirunaraiyūr-nādu, a district of Kulōttungaśola-vala-nādu.

cells.remarks: Registers the assignment of certain specified taxes by the king for the benefit of the god (Nambi), his consort and Šri-Rāma of Tirunaraiyūr in Chōlamaṇdalam at the request of Vaṇamalai-Āṇnagal of Arigaṇdapuram in Toṇdai-maṇdalam.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Tiruppandurai — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the central shrine of the Prāṇadēvara temple.

Purports to be the copy of an inscription, the original being on the stone brick temple of Tiruppandurai-Uḍaiyār was converted into a stone temple in the reign of Karikāla-Chōḷa, on which occa-sion the inscriptions previously engraved on the door-jambs and the walls of the (key-kavu) were copied on the temple (walls).

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Registers an agreement made by the sabhā of Tiruppan-turai and the temple servants for burning a perpetual lamp in the temple of Mahādēva at this village, in a shrine of Tiruvīraṭṭānam-uḍaiya-nāyaṉār-nīdu for the shp received by them from a barber named Pirāntakan Ādittan.

cells.location: TANJORE DISTRICT / KUMBAKONAM TALUK · Tiruppandurai † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the shrine of the Prāṇadēvara temple †

cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Mentions the brahmadēya village Tiruppandurai[rai] and one Nittakalyaṇiyum.

cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land and house-site by a lady of Āraśūr in Ārkāṭṭu-kūrram, a subdivision of Pāṇḍikuḷā-śani-vaḷanāḍu, for the expenses of the procession etc. of the goddess, and for the daily worship of the god, goddess, Periyadēva and Ānradēva and for their offerings after their bath in the Āraśāru (river).

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUR TALUK · Desidoddi (near Vanamaldinne) † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab forming the side of a dolmen in front of the Añjanēya temple. †
cells.remarks: States that this is the Parammakkap-kal (sasti sto) set up in memory of the daughter (name lost) of Ta.nurī [Piridi](Prithiv)rāma-Seṭti, the gāmuṇa of Idaiyūr, who entered the field.

cells.place: On a side of another dolmen in front of the temple of Vishnu. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. In characters of about the 10th century. A.D. Records the grant of land made in memory of a person who died in company with Dōrarma and Puljiyamma the younger brother of Prithivirāma-Seṭti, the son of Balimūrkka-Gavuṇa of Edeyūr, on the occasion of the destruction of a village (in a batale). Mentions Mārajavādi and Nolamba.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUR TALUK · Vanamaldinne — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone set up to the west of the village.
cells.king: Rĵjarāja-Mummudi-Chōla, 'the lord of Ta.ñjai' and 'the king of the Chōlas.'
cells.remarks: Registers the remission of the siddhāya tax payable by the ryots and the paddy, in accordance with the previous custom.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUR TALUK · Vanamaldinne † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On two pieces of a broken slab lying in a field to the north of the village.
cells.remarks: In characters of the 9th century A.D. States that a certain Nilagandan, the son of Mugdan of the (community 'o) Mārilitataras (goldsmiths) and a servant of Prince Bijayāditya, having died after capturing the fort of Ariyapali, a gift of land as bālpa'chu and as an aduvu (?) was male in his memory. Records the gift of a land by the king as kalnādu in memory of Nāgita-Mūlagundura who died in a cattle-raid led by hostile chiefs.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUR TALUK · Vanamaldinne † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another slab set up in a field to the north of the village, temple of Vishnu. †
cells.date: M.hābali-Bāparasa, 'ruling over the Vadugavali-Twelve thousand and Ganga-Six thousand provinces.'
cells.remarks: In characters of the 9th century A.D. States that a certain Nilagandan, the son of Mugdan of the (community 'o) Mārilitataras (goldsmiths) and a servant of Prince Bijayāditya, having died after capturing the fort of Ariyapali, a gift of land as bālpa'chu and as an aduvu (?) was male in his memory. Records the gift of a land by the king as kalnādu in memory of Nāgita-Mūlagundura who died in a cattle-raid led by hostile chiefs.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUR TALUK · Vanamaldinne † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a third slab set up in a field to the north of the village, temple of Vishnu. †
cells.date: M.hābali-Bāparasa, 'ruling over the Vadugavali-Twelve thousand and Ganga-Six thousand provinces.'
cells.remarks: Records the death of a certain Aṇṇalam Kittappan, son of Tikiram Dhammāḍu-Setti in a cattle-raid by the Vaidumba, and states that his koḷaga adopted son (?) Mūmali-Poṭṭi received the field in memory. He fell and the lan l (given in his memory).

cells.place: On a fourth slab in a field to the north of the village, temple of Vishnu. †
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 9th century A.D. Records the gran[t] of M.rashigarasa as kaḷanī in memory of Kaḍakuṭi the gran[t]son of Miḷigun ura, who fell in a cattle-raid at Eḍeyūru, while Prithivīpati-arasa was ruling the nāḍu.

cells.place: On a fifth slab (with a panel of figure relief) lying in a field to the north of the village, temple of Vishnu. †
cells.remarks: In characters of the 8th century A. D. Seems to record a sarvamānya (tax-free) gift of some land to the village Kundhanūru.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUR TALUK · Vanamaldinne † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a sixth slab set up in a field to the north of the village, temple of Vishnu. †
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land by Śarvavya while he was ruling the Puli-nāḍu. It mentions a certain Poḷḷeya who died during the destruction of the village Eḍe-ūru.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUR TALUK · Vanamaldinne † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a seventh hero-stone set up in a field to the north of the village. †
cells.remarks: Refers to Pallava-Dhavala as ruling the Puli-nādu. Records grant of land made in memory of Kumbura Munđeya, who resisted the cattle-raid made by Dāmarasa against Iđoyūru and died while attsæking him at Mūnandimangala.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUR TALUK · Edura — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the base of the Śiva temple.
cells.remarks: Begirs with the introduction Pugalmādu etc Records the construction of a tank called Madhurāntakappērēri to the east of Alińjanēri by Tir umāl Madhurāntakań alias Narasingavarman and his tax-free gift of land irrigated by it, to the temple of Šrikarajiśvaram-uđaiya-Mahādēva at Iđaiyūr alias Šembiyań-Šrikarapanallūr in Puli-nādu, a subdivision of Perumbāņappāđi, a district of Irattapādikondaśōļa-mandalam.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUR TALUK · Edura † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Śiva temple. †
cells.date: Śaka 1282 expired, Śārvari, Śrāvaṇa, śu. 10, Thursday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 203: Saka 1282 (expired), Śarvari, Śrāvaṇa, śu. 10, Thursday = A.D. 1360, July 23, Thursday ; f.d.t. ·27.]
cells.remarks: Records a grant of land by the dēvadāna lands of the temple of Vaḷattīśvara-Nāyaṇār at Viḍaiyūr together with two other villages and the several taxes accruing from them, by the mahājanas of the village. Uḍaiyar was the son of Mahāpradhāni Sōmappa-Uḍaiyar for the offerings and festivals in the temple which had fallen into disuse for fifty years previously.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUR TALUK · Edura † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the side slab of a dolmen, a furlong from the Śiva temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a grant of land made by Tāndūrań Virarājēndra Puliyūr-Nādālvān to a certain Maraiyań Kurugumāđi, probably for some act of heroism.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUR TALUK — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab called puḷravai set up in a field two furlongs from the same temple.
cells.remarks: Records that Māchchan, the son of Abhimāna-Muttaraiyań, a hunter of Iđaiyūr alias Šembiyań-Šrikarapanallūr in Puli-nādu, a subdivision of Perumbāņappāđi, a district of Jayańgondaśōļa-mandalam, pierced a tiger and died.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUR TALUK · Tamarapaḍipalle (near Vanamala-dinne) — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab called puḷravai set up in a field two furlongs from the Śiva temple. †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record the construction of a tank and the grant of top of land irrigated by it to one Tammuraya by Koneribhoja-Nāyaka.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUR TALUK · Siddareḍḍipalle (near Vanamala-dinne) — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab lying in a field to the west of the village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record the grant of an agrahāra to Kuṇḍekavaram Narasiṃhaya by Immaḍi-Chikkaharya of Suguṭūru.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUR TALUK · Mūḍipalle (near Vanamala-dinne) — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab lying in a field to the west of the village.
cells.remarks: Gives the genealogy of the king from Iriva-Noḷamba. States that the king conferred certain honours upon Basavayya, son of the chief minister, after the king had received the title Pallavāditya Noḷamba-Gāvuṇḍa, and also granted him the village Nagekuṇṭe in Puḷi-nāḍu. See part II, para 8.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUR TALUK · Puṅganūr — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the north wall of the Māṇikyavaradarjāsvāmin temple.
cells.date: 12th year (in words) which was [also] the 14th year (in words).
cells.remarks: Records the conferment of the accountancy of the village (ūr-kaṇakkak-kāṇi) upon Aḍavallāṉ, son of Gaṅgaikoṇḍāṉ of Kāñchīpuram, a nagara in Eyiṛ-kōṭṭam, a subdivision of Jayaṅgoṇḍasōḷa-maṇḍalam, by the assembly of Kuṅganūr alias Vaḷavanārāyaṇa-chaturvēdimaṅgalam in Puli-nāḍu, a subdivision of Perumbāṇappāḍi in the same maṇḍalam.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUR TALUK · Puṅganūr † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the north, west and south walls of the Māṇikyavaradarjāsvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Stones lost. Records grant of four daṇḍakas of land for offerings in the temple of Karumēṇikkaṭṭālvār at Puṅganūr by a certain Vāmanavāṉaṉ Kūṭṭapperumāḷ.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · CHITTOOR DISTRICT—cont. / PUNGANUE TALUK—cont. — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the south and east walls of the Māṇikyavaradarjāsvāmin temple. †
cells.remarks: Portions lost. Records the gift of certain taxes to the same temple by the chief Uttamachōḷa-Gaṅga alias Śalva-Gaṅga. Mentions Kuvalāḷapura].

cells.place: On a slab lying in the Lūgiyata-maṭha.
cells.remarks: Kannada .. Much damaged. Records an endowment to a temple (name lost) by Immađi-Chikarāya, son of Chikkarāya-Tammaya-Gauđa of Sugutūru, for the merit of his parents.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Puṅganūr † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone in the sluice of the tank, at the west end of the Veṅkaṭaramaṇasvāmi street.
cells.remarks: States that this tank was constructed by Muddamma, the daughter of Gūḍapalle Veṅkaṭapati-Nāyaka and the wife of Tammaya-Gauḍa of Suguṭūru, (who) was the son of Vīra-Chikkārāya, (the temple of) Jagadīśvara.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Puṅganūr † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the west and south walls of the Śiva temple near the tank near the Kulaśēkhar (Saundararāja-Perumāḷ) temple. †
cells.remarks: Records the improvements made to the shrine of the Hanuman by Mummadi-Chikkārāya and to the shrine of Hanuman by Mummadi-Chikkārāya.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Puṅganūr † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in the courtyard of the Veṅkaṭaramaṇasvāmi temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1739, Īśvara, śu 30, solar eclipse. [date-calculation appendix, No. 215: Saka 1739, Īśvara, Vaiśākha, ba. 30, solar-eclipse = A.D. 1817, May 16, Friday ; 28 ; solar-eclipse.]
cells.remarks: Registers grants etc., made to the temple of Kaliyāṇa-Veṅkaṭēśvara at Puṅganūru by Immaḍi-Śaṅkarāya of the Sāḍava-gōtra and the Suguṭūru.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Puṅganūr † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up near the entrance of the Rāmasvāmi temple in the Bazaar street.
cells.remarks: In modern characters. Settles the rates of contributions payable by the several v llages of the Puṅganūru-sīma, by Tammaya-Gauḍavaru (cf. gauṇḍaru), instead of farming the revenue of the sīma.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Melamdoḍḍi — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone in the sluice of the Jaṅgalapalle tank.
cells.remarks: In characters of about the 15th century A.D. States that this tank was dug by a certain Šelvichchi, wife of Mallan Daṇachi of Iđaiyūr, and called Mallanēri (after him).

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Aiajaṇūru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a rock in a hollow to the south of the village.
cells.remarks: Records a sarvamānya grant of land by two persons to a certain Dēśabōya, son of ĵppāra-G ṅgaye, as remuneration for having closed up a breecn in the tank at Aliñjanēri without any wages (kūli) and for repairing the same in future.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Eṭūru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a hero-stone lying in a field to the north of the village.
cells.remarks: Records the death of Prithivirāma-Setṭi, the son of Kāseṭa Nerīlūrar, in a cattle-raid at Maṅgala, while Vajjaradēva w. s ruling the Puli-nāđu. The engraver was Vikramādītya, son of Bijayitāchāri of Kōyātur.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Mallurupalle — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: (hamlet of F-ndapalle)—On a stone in the sluice of the tank.
cells.remarks: Records the allotment of the lands under the tank at Nallūrahajji between the god Agastṇanātha and Tambi-Setṭi, who constructed the tank under the direction of Timmaya[Sa]marasa.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Mallurupalle † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone set up in a field near the Viṣṇu temple.
cells.remarks: Records a grant of taxes on some lands at Nallūru to the temple of Agaśyanātha for the merit of the king by several officials of the place under o drs of the king's Mahīpradhāni Sōma-Udaiyar who receives the Saṅgia-Sūkyāyara and Gūṇaparamō-mahēśvara.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Gūḍūrpalle (near Kummanattam) — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a rock by the side of a spring near a deserted shrine.
cells.remarks: States that this pond was dug by Mummadi Ch k rāya, son of Immaḍi Chikkārāya of Suguṭūru and Dēva-ammāṇi, the daughter of Viṭṭalā rāji Grmnu.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Makkambaḍa (near Kummaranattam) — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in the compound of the Jaṅgamamaṭha.
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to record an endowment by Mummuđi Chikkarāya, son of Immađi Chikkarāya of Sugutūru to his religious preceptor.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Kaṭipūri — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in a field to the east of the village.
cells.remarks: Records a grant of land by Chikkarāya Tamma-Gauṇḍaru of Sugutūru, to his teacher (guruvāmi) Bhūpālapuri, on the day of a festival.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Kaṭipiri † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a rock in a field to the north-west of the village.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of a field to the temple of Viśvanāthasvāmi of Kāṭupūri.

cells.date: Śaka 1314 expired, Śrīmukha, Māgha, ba. 5, Thursday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 226: Saka 1314 (expired), Śrīmukha, Māgha, ba. 5, Thursday = A.D. 1394, January 22, Thursday ; ‘99. Śrīmukha was correctly Saka 1315, expired.]
cells.remarks: Bukka is referred to as the governor of the Muḷuvāyi-rājya. Records a grant of land and money-income by Baipa-Nāyaka to a certain Saṅga-Gauḍa for having constructed the Kaṇṇegore tank at Arekere in Hulinaḍu.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Peddaveḷagaturu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in the courtyard of the Varadarājasvāmi temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1327 (in words), Tāraṇa, Jyaishṭha, śu. 5, Wednesday, Pushya. [date-calculation appendix, No. 227: Saka 1327 (in words), Tāraṇa, Jyēshṭha, śu. 5, Wednesday, Pushya = A.D. 1404, May 14, Wednesday ; ‘50; ‘45. The Saka year quoted was current.]
cells.remarks: Records the construction of the temple of Varadarājadēva at Hiriya-Veḷagūru in Huḷi-nāḍu, which was a sub-division of the Muḷuvāya-rājya and a gift of land as sarvamānya to the temple by Lakkuya-Nāyaka, son of Māyappa, who was then the chief sentry of the pradhāna [Jo]hṇamma-Oḍeya.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Peddaveṅgaṭūru † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone-pillar lying in the field in front of the Varadarājasvāmi temple. †
cells.date: Sarvadhāri, Kār-ttika, śu. 1, Sunday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 228: Sarvadhāri, Kārttika, śu. 1, Sunday = A.D. 1408, October 20, Saturday; -33. Sunday is evidently a mistake for Saturday.]
cells.remarks: Records the grant of the village Hiriya-Veḷagūru in Muḷuvāya-nāḍu as sarvamānya by the king for the daily offerings and worship of the deity Varadarāja and of the goddess Bharaṇṇadēvi at Śrīparvata and for feeding thereof ten Brahmans daily.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Peddaveṅgaṭūru † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a hero-stone in a tope to the east of the tank called Ammaḷla-cheruvu.
cells.remarks: Records the death of Dēvendara-Muṇḍiappa in a cattle-raid. The Bāṇa king is mentioned as governing the village. The sculptor of the figure in relief was Īśvaradāsa, son of Keṇḍamma belonging to the royal palace and Muḷuvāṭe.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Peddaveṅgaṭūru † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another hero-stone in a tope to the east of the tank called Ammaḷa-cheruvu. †
cells.remarks: Records the death of a hero, the son of Kalivēṇṭi in a skirmish. The gift of a hero-stone in memory of this hero and of Muṇḍappa (of the above record), while Balasōma-Bhaṭṭara was administering the village.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Pasupattūru — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab in a field to the east of the village.
cells.remarks: In modern characters. Records the gift of a field to a temple by a person who is described as having built a stone-sluce in the big tank at Pāśupattūr, a village belonging to the temple of Varadarāja-Perumāḷ.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Guṇḍugalu — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the base of a dhvajastambha in a betel-garden called Kaṃbaḍagada-maḍi.
cells.date: Šaka 1322, Vikrama, Prathama-[Chai]-tra, ba. 8, Wednesday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 232: Saka 1322, Vikrama, Prathama-Chaitra, ba. 8, Wednesday = A.D. 1400, March 17, Wednesday ; f.d.t. ·54.]
cells.remarks: Records the gift of a row of lamps in the temple of Mallikārjunadēva at Śrīparvata by seven brothers of the goḷḷamatha caste residing at Guṇḍugalu, during the regime of Mallinātha, the brother of Dēvarāya, who was the agent of Bhikshāvitti Sūḍi-Dēvāya-Oḍeya.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Guṇḍugaḷu † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone set up in a field called 'Śēshappa-maḍi', to the west of the village.
cells.remarks: Records the remission of the bhikshāvritti taxes due by the barbers in the Guṇđugandi-sthala, by N. lagonda-manāyati Bāli-Nayaka on the representation of the barber Siṅgōju.

cells.place: On a rock in a field called 'Śēshappa-maḍi'.
cells.remarks: Danaṇed. Mentions Vāraṇāsi Bhikshāvritti ayya and records a gift of land made to the god Mallikārjuna dēva on the day of Śiva*ātri.

cells.location: CHITTOOR DISTRICT / PUNGANUE TALUK · Śivādi † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a hero-stone set up in a field to the north of the village.
cells.remarks: Records the death of a certain Kuruṇāgan in a skirmish of the gāmuṇḍas (gāmuṇḍa-makshara) on behalf of the village, while Śiyapaḍi in the gāmuṇḍas (gāmuṇḍa-makshara).

cells.place: On a hero-stone set up in another field adjacent to the field to the north of the village. †
cells.remarks: Records the death of Āguti on behalf of the village in a skirmish of the gāmuṇḍas (gāmuṇḍa-makshara).
